screen.zeldaswordskills_remastered.skill: Continuous Dash
Double-tap attack again during Dash's invulnerability window.

A five-level skill. Requires learned and enabled Basic Sword Skill and Dash. Tap attack twice within 10 ticks; each round accepts only one double-tap. Levels 1/2/3/4/5 allow 1/2/3/4/5 additional Dashes.

When the current Dash ends, immediately Dash toward the current locked target. If it has already ended but its immunity remains, Dash immediately. Each additional Dash uses the same damage, distance and invulnerability duration as Dash at its corresponding level. Each additional Dash costs 10 magic exactly once when it successfully starts.

Invulnerability continuously covers every Dash. Invalid target, insufficient magic or failed launch consumes neither magic nor an additional Dash.

Activation
After a successful sword parry, keep locked on to the parried enemy, jump and press the attack button within 20 + (2 × Helm Splitter level) ticks.

While locked on, successfully dodge a target's melee attack. Within the next 60 ticks, double tap the forward key to dash 2 blocks behind the enemy. Press the attack button once within 20 ticks of starting the dash to follow up with an attack.
Adds an extra heart upon use.
While on the ground and locked onto a target, double tap the forward key, then press the attack button to dash towards the target.
While on the ground, double tap the left or right movement key to dodge in the corresponding direction. Can be used empty-handed, no need to lock onto a target.
Press the jump button again in the air to perform a double jump.
When the locked target's health is below 10%, wait for Ending Blow to trigger, and land a critical jump attack on the target within its 60-tick window.
During the descent after a double jump or after launching an enemy with Rising Cut and launching yourself again, press the attack button to hit the enemy.

When not locked onto a target and the main hand is empty, let the enemy be continuously visible in a 120° field of view and within 5 blocks for 40 ticks to enter a ready stance. Switch to a melee weapon from the hotbar and hit the marked enemy within 40 ticks.
While holding a sword and locked onto a target, hold the use button to enter a defensive stance for 20 + (2 × Parry level) ticks. Raising a shield takes priority if equipped.
After locking onto a target, jump while sneaking and attack within 20 ticks to launch the target and yourself high into the air.
Hold the attack button to charge (takes 20 - skill level ticks), and release to unleash. Press the left/right key while charging to spin counterclockwise/clockwise.
At full health, double tap the attack button during the spin to continue to the next spin; you can press it repeatedly for more spins, but it will consume more magic.
Press %s to lock onto an enemy. The target must be an entity with autonomous AI, in clear sight and within lock-on range.
At full health, sneak on the ground and press the attack button.

After a successful parry, press the attack button within 20 + (2 × Sword Break level) ticks (22/24/26/28/30 ticks for levels 1-5 respectively) to release a follow-up attack on the parried enemy while remaining locked on.
Skill Description

Jump and attack after a successful parry, which immediately triggers an additional jump over the locked enemy's head. Does not need to be learned and does not consume double jump charges. Deals armor-piercing damage equal to [Weapon Damage + 1.5 × Helm Splitter level] to the parried enemy.

Provides immunity to damage from the locked enemy for 20 ticks from activation until the first landing. This descent prevents fall damage for a height of [Additional Jump Height + 5] blocks.

Successfully dodging a locked enemy's melee attack within 10 ticks of starting a dodge counts as a successful dodge. A successful dodge grants brief immunity to damage. Projectiles, magic, explosions, and environmental damage are not counted for success, but the dodge's base invincibility frames still apply.

Double tap the forward key within 60 ticks after a successful dodge to quickly dash next to the enemy.

Press the attack button within 20 ticks of starting the dash to unleash a flash assault, causing some knockback.

Each Heart Container increases maximum health by one heart. Heart Containers cannot be toggled in the skill book. You can use the command '/zss hearts set <amount>' to set the active extra hearts for a player, up to the configured limit.

While on the ground and locked onto a target, double tap the forward key and press the attack button to dash [3 + 1 × Skill level] blocks towards the target.

Dashing near or through the locked target deals [Weapon Damage + 1.5 × Level] damage.

Other enemies in the path each take sweep damage of [Weapon Damage + 0.5 × Level].

Invulnerability lasts [8 + 2 × Level] ticks: 10/12/14/16/18 ticks at levels 1-5.

Cooldown is [100 - 10 × Level] ticks.

Double tap the left or right key to dodge horizontally by about 4 blocks. When locked on, dodges in an arc around the target; when not locked on, glides sideways in a straight line.

Grants 4 ticks of complete damage immunity upon triggering, followed by a fixed 6-tick cooldown. Does not consume hunger. Dodging does not increase combo count or refresh the timer.

Allows one extra jump in the air, with a height of [0.75 + 0.25 × Skill level] blocks.

Can only be used once per airtime, resets immediately upon landing. Does not consume hunger.

When locking onto an enemy with health below 10%, there is a 2%/4%/6%/8%/10% (levels 1-5) chance every 20 ticks to trigger a 'Critical' state lasting 60 ticks.

During the 'Critical' state, landing a critical jump attack on the target deals armor-piercing damage equal to [Weapon Damage × 2/2.2/2.4/2.7/3.0]. This hit counts towards the basic sword combo but does not benefit from combo damage bonuses.

Successfully executing an ending blow consumes 6 hunger and 6 saturation, and incurs a 15-second cooldown. If you miss, the state ends and a 3-second cooldown is applied.

While locked on, if you attack and hit an enemy during the descent after a double jump, it is replaced by a Leaping Blow. A Leaping Blow deals [Weapon Damage + 2 × Level] armor-piercing damage to the locked enemy and [Weapon Damage + 0.75 × Level] armor-piercing damage to other enemies within a radius of [0.5 + 0.5 × Level] blocks.

Landing a Leaping Blow grants immunity to fall damage for that fall.

When not locked onto a target and the main hand is empty, enemies within a 5-block radius of your vision will accumulate observation time for 40 ticks. Eligible enemies will be marked, and you will enter a ready stance.

Quickly switching to a melee weapon to attack this enemy will unleash a Mortal Draw. The stance lasts at most 100 ticks and is canceled immediately if the target moves more than 5 blocks away.

Mortal Draw deals [Weapon Damage + 2.5 × Level] armor-piercing damage. Successfully hitting the marked target, hitting another entity, target invalidation, player-state invalidation, taking damage, or manual cancellation clears the mark and starts a 10-second (200-tick) cooldown.

While locked on, holding right-click with a weapon will enter a blocking stance. When attacked by the locked target, completely negates the damage and stuns the enemy for 20 ticks.

Successfully parrying, releasing the button early, taking actual damage, or timing out will end the defensive stance and trigger a 60-tick cooldown.

Launches the enemy into the air with an upward slash, launching yourself as well to follow up.

The descent after being launched can trigger a Leaping Blow (if learned). Provides fall damage immunity for a certain height.

When unleashed, the Spin Attack lasts for 8 ticks, rapidly rotating the camera and dealing [Weapon Damage + 1.5 × Skill level] damage to all enemies within range. Does not consume hunger. Camera returns to normal afterwards, and target lock is not canceled.

The Super Spin Attack expands the attack range and allows for continuous spinning. Requires full health to unleash. Each rotation will consume an additional [5.75 - 0.75 × Super Spin Attack level] magic.

Locking on fixes your gaze on the enemy and displays a bouncing yellow marker on the crosshair. Lock-on only works on entities with autonomous AI.

Consecutive hits build up a combo count, increasing basic attack damage. Sword skill hits that deal damage also build up the combo.

If the locked target dies, the lock automatically switches to the next attackable entity.

Missing, timing out, reaching the combo limit, manually switching locks, or losing the lock without a new target to switch to will end the combo.

Focuses energy into the sword blade and fires a sword beam to attack distant enemies.

Requires full health.
Levels 1-5 deal 30%/40%/50%/60%/75% of weapon damage respectively. Range is [8 + Level] blocks. Each release has a fixed cooldown of 40 ticks.

The sword beam does not increase combo count or combo damage, nor does it refresh the combo timer.

After a successful parry, tapping the attack button on the locked enemy will execute a counterattack, dealing [Weapon Damage + 1.2 × Sword Break level] armor-piercing damage and knocking them back about 4 blocks.

Upon successful execution, the enemy will be additionally snared for 40 ticks.

Sword skills are unlocked by collecting and using skill orbs. All advanced sword skills require the basic sword skill as a prerequisite.
By default, you are gifted a basic sword skill orb when you first enter a world; other skill orbs must be acquired through exploration or combat.
Each sword skill is triggered differently and can be combined to form smooth, practical 'combos'.
